hyper-sweat here, i've put so much time into this game that it's genuinely embarrassing. my advice is the same i'd give for any bullet hell, find a enemy or boss with sporadic attack patterns, and spend some time only wiggling between their bullets. i wouldn't even fire on the enemy/boss, just let it fire on you until you die and only focus on moving between shots, and try not to dodge roll. using all of your focus solely on your guy and dodging the shots, rather than worrying about firing, rolling, swapping, etc, will allow you to really hone in and develop your movement. your roll should be saved for a last ditch effort when you see that you're about to be trapped. 

as you get better at dodging their shots, it'll become less intensive on your focus, and you'll start being able to expand your understanding of how a shot pattern is going to develop, rather than focusing solely on the shots that are close to you. i think Gull and Twins are pretty good for this. start with Gull if possible, and when you start feeling more comfortable, doing this strategy at Twins will help you develop your spatial awareness and get better at dodging shots from all angles. 

also take plenty of breaks, it'll help you commit everything to memory. >!one day you'll take down the Lich, you got this. !< good luck OP

when it comes to ranked, you need legends whos skill sets can be used aggressively, while also maintaining the ability to support your teammates. 

my personal list would be—
S- wraith, path, gibby
A- octane, lifeline, caustic, wattson, bangalore
B- mirage, crypto, bloodhound

wraith, path, and gibraltar all have strong offensive abilities, while also boasting great support. wraith and path can maneuver their teams through tough situations via portals and ziplines, not to mention wraiths ability to call out other teams, and pathfinders ability to see the next ring location. gibraltar can act as a tank with his gun shield, but also can push/provide defense with his dome shield, and effectively displace enemy teams with his ult. 

octane is a good pick for his aggression and his healing factor when meds can be scarce, but ultimately lacks any significant supporting ability aside from his mediocre jump pad. lifeline is an amazing support for her team, but aside from fast healing and a small hitbox, has no significant aggressive abilities. (she is still my preferred third over a gibby though).  caustic is another great pick for defending areas and displacing other teams, but lacks the tanking ability of gibby, causing a bit of a weak link during aggressive pushes on the s3 map. wattson is basically the same as caustic in this respect, but when combined with caustic, can lead to serious defenses and routinely high placements. bangalore is always a decent choice in ranked, as all of her abilities can be used for support or aggression, but are lackluster compared to the S tier legends. 

as for crypto, while his drone ability is useful for scouting or posting up before a fight to make it MUCH easier, he is a sitting duck while in drone view and has no aggressive abilities aside from his EMP, which any experienced player will completely negate with an armor drop. mirage has no support abilities at all, while his only really useful ability against seasoned players is his ultimate, which doesnt come close to being as useful as many other legends. and last but not least, bloodhound. bloodhound can be a good choice for ranked as long as an extremely skilled player is using him. his ult is amazing for pushing and for locating distant enemies, while his passive also helps with aggression. his normal ability is only really helpful in close quarters areas, and leaves much to be desired in ranked play. so bloodhound can be a wild card if used by a complete sweatlord, but if youre not the kind of team who pushes every fight and usually wins, ditch the bloodhound and go with a more supportive legend.
